name: ManageEngine OpUtils
description_en:
ManageEngine OpUtils manages IP addresses and switch ports, with current editions extending into DNS and DHCP management. Its documented workflows include subnet discovery, scheduled scanning, role-scoped access and database backup/migration.

A pilot should establish both observation and control boundaries. Adding a subnet may initiate scanning, operators have different rights from administrators, and a migration depends on build compatibility and separate license files. Use an authorized small test range before trusting inventory or planning a production move.
description_zh:
ManageEngine OpUtils 管理 IP 地址和交换机端口，当前方案还扩展到 DNS、DHCP。文档流程涵盖子网发现、计划扫描、按角色限制范围及数据库备份／迁移。

试点应同时明确观察和控制边界：添加子网可能启动扫描，Operator 与 Administrator 权限不同，迁移则依赖 build 兼容及独立许可文件。应先使用获准的小型测试地址段，再判断清单或规划生产迁移。

core_features.explanation_en: Operator is read-only; module and tree-group scopes can narrow user access.
core_features.explanation_zh: Operator 为只读，可按模块及树分组缩小用户访问范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose ICMP, SNMP, DNS and WMI collection options and configure scheduled scans.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择 ICMP、SNMP、DNS 和 WMI 采集选项，并配置计划扫描。

core_features.name_zh: 密码保护的数据库恢复
core_features.explanation_en: BackupDB/RestoreDB workflows require the retained backup password and version-appropriate files.
core_features.explanation_zh: BackupDB／RestoreDB 流程需要保留备份密码及版本匹配文件。

en: Evaluate a small authorized subnet and compare discovery results with known devices.
Rehearse a same-build migration using disposable database content.
zh: 评估获准小子网，将发现结果与已知设备比较。
使用可丢弃数据库内容演练相同 build 迁移。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose a test range and probe types, confirm device prerequisites and restrict operator scope.
steps.zh: 选择测试地址段及探测类型，核对设备前提并限制 Operator 范围。

steps.en: Create a separate recovery backup, retain its password and verify build/format compatibility before migration.
steps.zh: 建立独立恢复备份、保留密码，迁移前核对 build／格式兼容。

items.en: Upgrade-generated backups are explicitly excluded from restoration.
items.zh: 升级生成备份明确不支持恢复。

items.en: A scan and a network-changing action require different access decisions.
items.zh: 扫描与改变网络的动作需要分别决定授权。

pricing.summary_en: The homepage documents Free plus Professional/Management paid editions, licensed by managed IP/port counts with subscription/perpetual options. Displayed $138/$159 starting figures lack a reliable term mapping in the read output, so no monthly rate is normalized. User packs, add-ons and final quote remain separate.
pricing.summary_zh: 首页记录 Free 及 Professional／Management 付费版，按托管 IP／端口数量许可，并有订阅／永久选项。展示的 $138／$159 起价无法可靠对应期限，因此未标准化月价。用户包、附加项及最终报价另行核对。

Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Adding a range can start active scanning
sections.title_zh: 添加地址段可能开始主动扫描
sections.en: Router-discovered subnets need review and approval before scanning, while manually adding a subnet initiates a scan. CSV import has a separate scan option. Review the exact input path and selected ICMP/SNMP/DNS/WMI probes before adding a real range; importing inventory is not always a passive operation.
sections.zh: 路由器发现的子网需审核批准后扫描，手动添加则会启动扫描，CSV 导入另有扫描选项。添加真实地址段前，应检查具体输入路径和 ICMP／SNMP／DNS／WMI 选择，导入清单并非始终被动操作。

sections.en: The prerequisite matrix distinguishes tools that need SNMP/MIB support from ping or DNS utilities that do not. Switch Port Mapper lists bridge-related MIB requirements. Validate the target device and credentials for the chosen tool rather than assuming a successful ping proves port mapping or device detail collection will work.
sections.zh: 前提矩阵区分需要 SNMP／MIB 的工具与不需要的 ping、DNS 工具。Switch Port Mapper 列有桥接相关 MIB 要求，应核对目标设备及凭据。ping 成功不能证明端口映射或设备详情采集可用。

sections.title_zh: 区分查看与改变网络的动作
sections.en: Administrators can configure devices, alerts and scans; Operators cannot initiate scans or add/delete devices. Port enable/disable and rogue-device blocking are administrative actions. The user guide also offers module/tree-group scope. Test a limited operator’s visible ranges and denied actions before granting a broader role.
sections.zh: Administrator 可配置设备、告警及扫描，Operator 不能发起扫描或增删设备。端口启停、可疑设备阻断属于管理动作。用户指南也提供模块／树分组范围，应先测试受限 Operator 可见地址段及被拒操作，再授予更广角色。

sections.title_en: Keep a restorable backup and its password
sections.title_zh: 保留可恢复备份及密码
sections.en: The database backup guide says backup passwords are not stored by the utility. From12.8.510 the supported archive changes from ZIP to7z; restore requires the password. It explicitly excludes backups taken during upgrade from restoration. Maintain an independent recovery backup and verify it on a disposable installation.
sections.zh: 数据库备份指南说明工具不存储备份密码。从 12.8.510 起支持格式由 ZIP 改为 7z，恢复需密码；指南明确升级过程产生的备份不可恢复。应另保留独立恢复备份，并在可丢弃安装中验证。

sections.title_en: Match the target build and preserve licensing
sections.title_zh: 匹配目标 build 并保留许可
sections.en: The server migration guide requires installing the same build on the destination, confirming startup and stopping it before restoration. License-related files are copied separately. Its older ZIP examples must be read alongside the newer backup-format guide; do not assume arbitrary newer builds can restore an older archive without a documented path.
sections.zh: 服务器迁移指南要求目标端安装相同 build，确认启动后在恢复前停止服务，许可相关文件另行复制。旧 ZIP 示例需结合较新备份格式指南理解，不能假定任意新版均可直接恢复旧存档。

sections.title_en: Keep edition, counts and license term together
sections.title_zh: 同时核对版本、数量及许可期限
sections.en: The homepage lists Free for one class-C subnet and switch, Professional at $138 for250 IPs/ports, and Management at $159 for250 IPs/ports. It exposes subscription/perpetual selection, but the read output does not reliably bind each displayed amount to a term. Obtain the selected edition’s actual quote and user/add-on scope.
sections.zh: 首页列 Free 用于一个 C 类子网及交换机，Professional 为 250 IP／端口 $138，Management 为 250 IP／端口 $159。页面有订阅／永久许可选择，但读取结果无法可靠将金额绑定到期限。需取得所选版本真实报价，核对用户及附加项。
